pages.text: Having wandered the whole of the drought-scorched hills and traded blows with the serpon combat teams, you found yourself eyeing the serpon's prowess - and set your mind to finding a quick way of.$(br)calling on these wanderers. Talking with them, applying your own knowledge of the dark arts, and a few attempts later, you found it: a swift way to raise these reinforcements.

Casting with a $(l:crafts/staff/nether_staff)Nether Staff$() raises more colonial soldiers and pioneers: a plain staff raises one, an even chance of either, while a Nether Staff raises two of each. Sixteen at most per owner.
